posts.title: Signed Webhooks Still Need Replay Defense
bullets: Verify the raw payload signature using the endpoint signing secret.
Reject stale requests with timestamp tolerance; do not disable freshness checks.
Record processed event IDs and make handlers idempotent; deliveries may repeat or arrive out of order.
posts.caption:
A valid webhook signature doesn't mean an event is new. Verify the raw payload and signing secret, enforce timestamp tolerance, and track processed event IDs to prevent duplicate actions. Events can also arrive out of order.
